previous_audits.verdict_rationale: The load-bearing step is an exact finite algebraic counterexample, not a definition, renaming, tuned numerical match, or external comparator check. Independent recomputation of the displayed fractions gives the runner's laws and certificate values: k1 and k2 share L(AA)=1/2 and L(AB)=1/2 while differing on the B row, and k3 and k4 share endpoint_AB=1/4 while other directed statistics separate them. The no-go is clean only in the scoped sense of no selection from directed certificates alone, not as a ban on separately supplied model-selection rules.
